name: BHI (Brain Heart Infusion) broth (PMC7159880)
description: BHI (Brain Heart Infusion) broth — medium reported in PMC7159880 (complex/undefined base — extracts not BiGG-mappable).

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC7159880 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Complex medium: chemically-defined portion mapped to BiGG; biological extracts listed in `unmapped`. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.base_expansion: Base 'BHI' expanded to standard composition: Brain Heart Infusion (BD): brain/heart infusion solids, peptone, NaCl, phosphate, dextrose (in-silico approximation).
provenance.verification_evidence: "Overnight cultures were inoculated from single colonies grown on BHI agar plates with streptomycin and incubated in sterile BHI (Remel) with streptomycin (120 µg/mL) overnight at 37C." and "Highly buffered media was prepared by supplementing standard BHI with 50 µM Dibasic Sodium Phosphate (Fisher)." The paper names BHI (Remel) as a commercial complex medium and does NOT define its chemical compo

Brain heart infusion + proteose peptone.citation: Proteose peptone = enzymatic protein digest — BD Bionutrient Technical Manual.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
